description: This file defines the CausalClock class which manages logical clock timestamps in a transactional system, providing methods for generating and merging timestamps in a thread-safe manner.

classes.name: CausalClock
classes.description: A class that provides thread-safe mechanisms to generate and merge logical timestamps based on a clock, used for causal ordering in transactions.

methods.name: CausalClock
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the CausalClock with a provided IClock instance.

methods.name: UtcNow
methods.description: Returns the current timestamp, ensuring monotonically increasing ticks.

methods.name: Merge
methods.description: Merges a provided DateTime timestamp with the current clock state and returns the resulting timestamp.

methods.name: MergeUtcNow
methods.description: Merges a provided DateTime timestamp with the current clock and returns a synchronized timestamp.
